source: Owner message in the active music design conversation
verbatim: I think we have a good sonic design, but I think the concept of having a band performing the soundtrack for this game is ideal. The cast provided so far is a good start, but it is not yet comprehensive, as the obvious missing role is a DJ/electronic type producer figure so that element can also be mixed with the music. The guide provided is the mission statement of the game, but taking a step back, and logically organizing it as a group of musicians, each with a clear historical reference point to help define stylistic or technique decisions when they are uncertain is a critical piece to the game design
scope: Overall sonic design endorsed as mission statement; organize the musical cast as a band with historical references and add a DJ/electronic producer.
acceptance_limit: The new role roster and detailed choices are proposed for review; no release approval or new in-game character commission inferred.
